definitions.explanation: a household where both partners are employed and contribute to the family income

examples.japanese: {共働|ともばたら}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夫婦|ふうふ}→夫婦：03592_fuufu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: The number of dual-income couples is increasing.

examples.japanese: {共働|ともばたら}きだ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{家事|かじ}→家事：12313_kaji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{分担|ぶんたん}→分担：11771_buntan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: When both work, sharing housework is important.

examples.japanese: {共働|ともばたら}きで⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{子育|こそだ}て→子育て：12226_kosodate⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{両立|りょうりつ}→両立：11310_ryouritsu⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Even with both working, they balance work and child-rearing.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
Dual-income households have outnumbered single-earner households in Japan since the late 1990s. Words that come up with it: {家事分担|かじぶんたん} (dividing the housework), ⟦{育児|いくじ}→育児：03998_ikuji⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{両立|りょうりつ}→両立：11310_ryouritsu⟧ (balancing childcare and work), ⟦{待機児童|たいきじどう}→待機児童：08624_taikijidou⟧ (children on daycare waiting lists).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{共稼|ともかせ}ぎ→共稼ぎ：18260_tomokasegi⟧ - the same meaning, written with ⟦{稼|かせ}ぐ→稼ぐ：02040_kasegu⟧ (to earn); a separate, somewhat older word, not another reading of {共働|ともばたら}き
